name: agentflow-desktop
description: Desktop agent for AgentFlow remote control
author: AgentFlow contributors <noreply@agentflow.local>

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');for (const name of ['terminal.js','terminal.js.map','project-runtime-rules.js','project-runtime-rules.js.map']) { const source=path.join('dist','renderer',name); if (fs.existsSync(source)) { fs.copyFileSync(source,path.join('renderer',name)); } }"
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run ensure-icons && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run ensure-icons && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.dist:win:x64: npm run build && npm run ensure-icons && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:x86: npm run build && npm run ensure-icons && electron-builder --win nsis --ia32 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb pacman --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:deb: npm run build && electron-builder --linux deb --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:arch: npm run build && electron-builder --linux pacman --publish never
scripts.dist:win:portable: npm run build && npm run ensure-icons && electron-builder --config electron-builder.portable.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:win:portable:x64: npm run build && npm run ensure-icons && electron-builder --config electron-builder.portable.yml --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:portable:x86: npm run build && npm run ensure-icons && electron-builder --config electron-builder.portable.yml --ia32 --publish never
